title: FB Bancorp, Inc. /MD/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: FB Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 29, 2026 reporting results from its Annual Meeting of Stockholders, including the election of three directors and ratification of its independent auditor. This is a routine corporate governance filing for a small regional bank (Nasdaq: FBLA, New Orleans-based) with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Three directors elected: J. Luis Baños, Jr. (6,495,768 for), Gerard W. Barousse, Jr. (9,251,989 for), Mark C. Romig (8,644,495 for)
EisnerAmper LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 (12,156,849 for, 524,989 against)
Company is an emerging growth company as defined by SEC Rule 405
FBLA common stock trades on Nasdaq Stock Market LLC
Event date: April 29, 2026; filing date: April 30, 2026
why_it_matters: This filing has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. It is a routine corporate governance disclosure from a small regional bank holding company. The director elections and auditor ratification represent standard internal governance matters with no broader market implications.
important_numbers: 6,495,768 votes for J. Luis Baños, Jr.
9,251,989 votes for Gerard W. Barousse, Jr.
